Hide_Mode.name: Hide_Mode
Hide_Mode.description: The value will influence when the dock is shown or hidden.

Plugins_Visible.name: The visibilities of plugins
Plugins_Visible.description: The loaded plugin which is visible when dock is started.

Locked.name: locked
Locked.description: lock dock to prevent dragging resize

cardCurrent.name: cardCurrent
cardCurrent.description: The surface id (pluginId::itemKey) of the card shown in the card area, restored on startup.
cardCurrent.description[zh_CN]: 卡片区域当前显示的卡片标识（pluginId::itemKey），任务栏重启后据此恢复。

enableShowDesktop.name: Enable ShowDesktop
enableShowDesktop.description: Enable or disable the show desktop area on the right side of the dock

enableContextMenu.name: Enable Dock Context Menu
enableContextMenu.description: Enable or disable the context menu on the empty area of the dock.
enableContextMenu.description[zh_CN]: 启用或禁用任务栏空白区域的右键菜单和触摸长按菜单。

enableFashionMode.name: Enable Fashion Mode
enableFashionMode.description: Allow switching the dock to fashion mode. When disabled, the fashion mode entry is hidden from the dock context menu and the dock falls back to centered mode.
enableFashionMode.description[zh_CN]: 是否允许把任务栏切换到时尚模式。关闭时任务栏右键菜单里不显示时尚模式入口，已保存的时尚模式也会回退成居中模式。
